synonymsNote: Keys are feature labels, absence-probe tokens, and recorded api paths. Regex absence probes are omitted. scales.x.title and scales.y.title are conventional Chart.js names for axis.title; that cell's recorded evidence is a grep (~title), not a type-checked path.

statuses.partial: Possible with limits (subset, workaround option, only some chart types)
statuses.plugin: Needs an official or community plugin/package (named in evidence)
statuses.manual: Only via the library's escape hatch (custom render/SVG/canvas code)
statuses.none: Not supported; verified by absence of matching identifiers in the shipped types/sources
statuses.unknown: Not verified. If present, `assessed` holds the unverified claim

verification.dts-path: Option path resolved with the TypeScript checker against the shipped .d.ts (strong)
verification.runtime-probe: ChartKit: rendered spec variants and diffed SVG output (strong)
verification.source-review: Probe hit in ChartKit source read by hand and found unrelated (strong for "none")
verification.dts-grep: Identifier regex matched in the library's types/sources (weak: shows the name exists, not semantics)
verification.dts-mechanism: "manual" claim — only the escape hatch was verified to exist (weak)
verification.npm: Plugin package exists on npm (weak: not tested)
verification.doc-cited: Cited from docs URL, not machine-checked (weak)
verification.dts-absence: "none" claim; the row probe regex matched no identifier/literal in the library corpus (moderate)
verification.unverified: No machine check passed; status forced to unknown
verification.conflict: "none" claim but the absence probe matched; forced to unknown pending review (see conflicts.md)
